raw_segments.text: So far as name goes, there is a pretty general agreement.
For happiness both the multitude and the refined few call it, and, living well, and doing well
they conceive to be the same with being happy.
But about the nature of this happiness, men dispute, and the multitude do not in their
account of it agree with the wise.
For some say it is some one of those things which are palpable and apparent, as pleasure
In fact, some one thing, some another.
Nay, oftentimes the same man gives a different account of it, for when ill he calls it health,
when poor wealth, and conscious of their own ignorance men admire those who talk grandly
Some again held it to be something by itself, other than and beside these many good things,
which is in fact to all these the cause of their being good.
